grammar.title: Prendere (To Take) with Transportation
grammar.explanation: The verb 'prendere' (to take) is commonly used with means of transportation: 'prendere il treno/l'autobus/l'aereo/un taxi'. It conjugates as: prendo, prendi, prende, prendiamo, prendete, prendono. You can also use 'andare in/con' for traveling: 'andare in treno' (to go by train), 'andare in aereo' (to go by plane). Note that 'a piedi' means 'on foot': 'Vado a piedi' (I go on foot).

examples.native: I take the eight o'clock train.
We go by plane to Naples.
I prefer to go on foot.
